## Installation ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/sheet ``` This also installs `button`, which the sheet uses for its close control and its footer actions. Install `@cadence/checkbox` and `@cadence/field` for the filter composition, and `@cadence/input` for the controlled form. ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useId, useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Checkbox } from "@/components/cadence/checkbox"; import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@/components/cadence/field"; import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@/components/cadence/sheet"; export function FiltersSheet() { const id = useId(); const [openOnly, setOpenOnly] = useState(true); const [applied, setApplied] = useState("Open only"); return (

Side panels use three quarters of the viewport with a desktop width cap; top and bottom panels span the width and size to content. ```tsx "use client"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@/components/cadence/sheet"; export function SheetEdges() { return (

This example provides an explicit Done action. ```tsx "use client"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@/components/cadence/sheet"; export function FooterCloseSheet() { return ( }>Open footer close View details The footer provides the visible close action.

Initial focus on the title opens the list at its beginning without jumping to a footer control. The entries link to the changelog, so Tab reaches the scrolling body and PageDown scrolls it without requiring a pointer. ```tsx "use client"; import { useRef } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@/components/cadence/sheet"; export function LongSheet() { const title = useRef(null); return ( }>Browse activity Activity Scroll the list while the footer stays in view.

}>Done ); } ``` ## Controlled form The caller owns open, draft and saved values. Save updates local state and closes; Cancel leaves the saved value unchanged and preserves the draft for reopening. No request or validation is performed. SheetContent always renders its backdrop, including false and trap-focus; use a suitable composition when the page must remain visually unobscured. ```tsx "use client"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@/components/cadence/sheet"; export function SheetModality() { return (
{([true, false, "trap-focus"] as const).map((modal) => ( }>{String(modal)} Mode: {String(modal)} Focus and scrolling follow the root modal setting. }>Done ))}
); } ``` ## Explicit motion scopes Ordinary sheets inherit the header clock. This comparison alone fixes none and then restores full in a nested scope. The OS reduced-motion preference still wins. Both the panel and its backdrop resolve the local clock. ```tsx "use client"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { CadenceProvider } from "@/components/cadence/lib/provider"; import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@/components/cadence/sheet"; export function SheetMotionScopes() { return (
}>Open without motion Immediate sheet No entering motion. }>Open nested full Nested full sheet The OS preference still wins.
); } ``` ## When to use - A task that should keep the page in view: filters, a details panel, settings for the thing behind it. - A form too tall or too wide for a `popover`, opened on purpose and dismissed on purpose. - Mobile navigation or a secondary menu, where a full dialog would feel heavy. ## When not to use - A confirmation that must be answered before anything continues. Use `alert-dialog`. - A hint about a control. Use `tooltip` or `hover-card`. - A flow with its own steps and URL. That is a page, not an overlay. ## API | Part | Props | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `Sheet` | `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `modal` | Base UI dialog root. | | `SheetTrigger` | native button props, `render` | Opens the sheet. | | `SheetContent` | `side` (`"right" \| "left" \| "top" \| "bottom"`), `showCloseButton`, `render`, `className` | Renders portal, overlay, and popup. | | `SheetOverlay` | `className` | Only needed when replacing `SheetContent`. | | `SheetPortal` | `container` | Available for a custom portal target. | | `SheetClose` | native button props, `render` | Closes the sheet. | | `SheetHeader` / `SheetFooter` | `className` | Padding and stacking only. | | `SheetTitle` | `className` | Required accessible name. | | `SheetDescription` | `className` | Supporting text. | ## Motion contract Each portal surface resolves its own mode and token clock. A nested full scope restores timing inside none (subject to the system preference). Live reduced cancels scale or slide and keeps opacity; none cancels transitions and shows the first frame immediately. Base parts accept `className(state)` and `style(state)`; caller values merge last. | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | enter | panel `opacity 0 → 1` + `translate` from its own size; backdrop `opacity 0 → 1` | `popup.anchored` · `duration.base` / `duration.fast` | yes | | exit | panel `opacity → 0` + `translate` back off its edge; backdrop `opacity → 0` | `exit.fade` · `duration.fast` | yes | | reduced | opacity only, no translate; the duration tokens run at 0.6× (132ms) | `exit.fade` | yes | | none | every `--motion-duration-*` resolves to `0ms`, so the panel is in place on the first frame | – | – | The slide is `translate-*-full`, the panel's own width or height, not a fixed distance: a side panel should enter from off its edge at every size, and a distance token would need one value per side. The transition list names `translate` rather than `transform` because Tailwind v4's `translate-*` utilities write the property individually — the same reason the dialogs transition `scale`. ## Keyboard interactions | Keys | Action | | --- | --- | | Tab / Shift+Tab | Cycles focus inside the sheet; focus never reaches the page behind it. | | Escape | Closes the sheet and returns focus to the trigger. | | Enter / Space | Activates the focused control. | The panel and backdrop resolve local token clocks from the effective mode and time scale, including full inside a parent none scope. None also removes starting/ending opacity classes, so no hidden starting frame remains. Caller state callback classes/styles still merge last. ## Accessibility - Base UI provides `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby`, focus trapping, focus return, scroll lock, and Escape handling. - `SheetTitle` is required: a sheet without an accessible name is invalid. `SheetDescription` becomes the description, so put the consequence there, not in a second paragraph. - The built-in close control is a button with a screen-reader-only "Close" label; it sits in the top-right corner at every side and never traps the focus ring. - A destructive footer action uses `variant="destructive"` plus a specific verb; the colour is never the only signal. ## Responsive behavior A right or left sheet is `w-3/4` capped at `sm:max-w-sm`; a top or bottom sheet spans the width with an auto height. Long content should scroll inside a wrapper (see "A long list"), so the footer stays reachable and the page behind does not move. ## Performance - One popup tree is mounted only while open; the overlay and panel unmount after the exit. - Animates `opacity` and `translate` only: the panel is `fixed` at its edge, so nothing reflows and the page behind never reads layout. - The close control is a `Button`, so its press feedback obeys the same motion mode as the sheet. ## Notes for AI - Use `sheet` for a task beside the page; use `alert-dialog` when the answer must be deliberate, and `popover` when the content is small and anchored to a control. - Always render `SheetTitle`; put the side effect of closing (reset, discard) in the footer, not in the title. - Name the footer action after its effect ("Apply filters"), not "OK". - If the sheet opens a form, remember P11: the sheet renders invalid state from `aria-invalid` but never validates anything itself.
